title: Type into an input
summary: send_keys types into an element. Read the value property to see what the field now contains.
introduction: send_keys types into an element. Read the value property to see what the field now contains. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: send_keys types into an element. Read the value property to see what the field now contains.

blocks.code:
from urllib.parse import quote
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
try:
    driver.get("data:text/html;charset=utf-8," + quote('<label for="title">Title</label><input id="title">'))
    field = driver.find_element(By.ID, "title")
    field.send_keys("Moon")
    assert field.get_property("value") == "Moon"
finally:
    driver.quit()
